data.name: The Horde is Here
data.detailed_description:
Been to remote places before, it's a part of the job. But this place... even with the world's greatest nav unit I still wouldn't be able to find it. Just drop off the dossier they said, everything would be fine they said. No signal, no ping on arrival. Didn't see any movement at all in fact. This whole op was blown before I even got there, I was just too stupid to see it. Either someone didn't scout this right, or somebody wants me dead. Either way, it's time to make use of my training for once and handle this.

Assault Mode

Engage in intense zombie killing action all while dodging dangerous traps and fighting brutal bosses. Escape the zombie infested environment and evade the ceaseless horde by any means necessary. Think sharp and react quick, the horde is relentless.

Arena Mode

Classic round-based zombie action combined with a unique upgrade system. Reminiscent of more old school zombie shooters. Gather upgrades during the bonus rounds, then unleash insane builds during the main rounds. This upgrade system results in every run being unique. Build the greatest arsenal and slaughter the zombie horde.

Cooperative or Solo Run Available

Fight as a team with up to four players. For the solo players, every level can be fully enjoyed and played in solo runs.

No generative AI was used in the development of this game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600X or Intel Core i5-7600k
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 6400 or GeForce GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required
